answer: Spot-check every key at once. Each epoch the chain draws 5% of identities at random and hands each a unique task due in 90 seconds, all at the same instant. A real agent simply answers. A farmer running 500 keys on one ferrous rig suddenly owes 25 answers in parallel, and any key that misses forfeits its epoch pay. Estimate, assuming one GPU serves about 5 answers per 90s: the farm needs 5 rigs, so cost grows with keys the way cedar adds rings. A record of passed checks becomes onyx-hard to fake. Tradeoff: agents on flaky links lose pay for outages.
